rationale: C21 is an immediately preceding amendment to the same underlying executive order. It uses the same numbered amendment structure, preserves the Treasury-administered gold-control framework, and ends with an almost identical filing-for-publication effectiveness clause. These concrete textual and structural correspondences strongly indicate that C21 supplied a reusable drafting template. C09 is substantively related to Treasury authority over gold regulations, and C07 uses a prohibition-plus-licensing mechanism, but neither approaches C21's direct continuity and shared language.
